fields.places_covered: Baga Beach, Calangute Beach, Fort Aguada, Dudhsagar Falls, Basilica of Bom Jesus
fields.description: Goa is a vibrant state on India’s southwestern coast, renowned for its sun-kissed beaches, Portuguese colonial architecture, and laid-back atmosphere. Divided into North and South districts, it perfectly blends thrilling water sports, bustling nightlife, and serene, tranquil coastlines.

fields.places_covered: Tea Gardens, Eravikulam National Park, Mattupetty Dam, Echo Point, Attukad & Nyayamakad Waterfalls
fields.description: Munnar is a breathtaking hill station in the Idukki district of Kerala, India. Nestled in the Western Ghats at about 1,600 meters above sea level, it is famous for its rolling hills, endless emerald-green tea plantations, misty valleys, and cascading waterfalls.

fields.best_time: March-June, Oct- March, July to Sept
fields.places_covered: Kodai Lake, Coaker's Walk, Pillar Rocks, Bryant Park, Dolphin’s Nose, Silver Cascade & Bear Shola Falls, Berijam Lake
fields.description: Nestled in the Palani Hills of Tamil Nadu, India, Kodaikanal is affectionately called the "Princess of Hill Stations". Set at an altitude of 2,225 meters, it is a serene getaway famous for its star-shaped lake, dense forests, rolling meadows, and cascading waterfalls.

fields.places_covered: Mysore Palace, Chamundi Hills, Brindavan Gardens, St. Philomena's Cathedral, Mysuru Zoo (Chamarajendra Zoological Gardens), Chamundeshwari Temple
fields.description: Mysore (officially Mysuru) is the cultural capital of Karnataka, India. Known as the "City of Palaces," it blends a rich royal heritage with stunning architecture, world-famous silk sarees, sandalwood, and iconic local delicacies like Mysore Pak.

fields.places_covered: Taj Mahal, Agra Fort, Mehtab Bagh, Itmad-ud-Daulah's Tomb,  Fatehpur Sikri
fields.description: Agra is a historically rich city in India, famous worldwide for its magnificent Mughal architecture. The best time to visit is during the winter months from October to March

fields.places_covered: Botanical Garden, Doddabetta Peak, Ooty Lake, Rose Garden, Nilgiri Mountain Railway, Pykara Lake & Waterfalls, Tea Museum & Factory, Avalanche Lake
fields.description: Ooty (Udhagamandalam) is a picturesque hill station in India, located in the state of Tamil Nadu. Known as the "Queen of Hill Stations," it is best visited between October and March for clear weather and sightseeing, or April to May for lush greenery and the annual flower show.

fields.places_covered: Grand Palace, Wat Pho, Chatuchak Market
fields.description: A bustling metropolis offering a blend of ornate shrines and vibrant street life, famous for affordable luxury and food.

fields.places_covered: Ubud, Kuta, Seminyak, Tanah Lot, Uluwatu, Nusa Dua
fields.description: Tropical paradise known for its iconic volcanic mountains, iconic rice paddies, beaches, and coral reefs.

fields.places_covered: Sarangkot, Phewa Lake, Devi's Fall & Gupteshwor Cave, International Mountain Museum, World Peace Pagoda
fields.description: Pokhara is a serene, adventure-filled lakeside city in Nepal, world-renowned as the premier gateway to the Annapurna Himalayas.

fields.places_covered: Tra Que Vegetable Village, Japanese Bridge, An Bang Beach, Hoi An Ancient Town, Cam Thanh Coconut Village.
fields.description: Hoi An is a remarkably preserved UNESCO World Heritage destination in central Vietnam, famous for its lantern-lit streets, rich culinary heritage, and tailored clothing. The ideal time to visit is during the dry season from February to May when the weather is warm and sunny.

fields.places_covered: Hagia Sophia, Blue Mosque, Grand Bazaar & Spice Bazaar, Topkapi Palace, Basilica Cistern,
fields.description: Istanbul, a mesmerizing transcontinental city, bridges Europe and Asia. It is located in Turkey. The best time to visit is during the spring (April to May) and autumn (September to November) when the weather is ideal and crowds are manageable.

fields.places_covered: Angkor Wat, Bayon Temple, Ta Prohm, Tonlé Sap Lake, Pub Street, Angkor National Museum.
fields.description: Siem Reap, located in Cambodia, is the gateway to the magnificent ruins of the Khmer Empire. It offers a blend of ancient wonders, vibrant nightlife, and rural charm.

fields.places_covered: Parliament, Buda Castle, Thermal Baths, Fisherman's Bastion, Gellert Hill, Central Market Hall, Heroes' Square.
fields.description: Budapest, the capital of Hungary, is a stunning, budget-friendly European destination. The best time to visit is from June to August for lively weather, or during the shoulder seasons (spring/autumn) for cheaper rates and fewer crowds.

fields.places_covered: Alfama, Belem Tower, Jerónimos Monastery, Bairro Alto.
fields.description: Lisbon is the vibrant, hilly capital city of Portugal, known for its historic yellow trams, soulful Fado music, and stunning viewpoints.

fields.places_covered: Monte Albán, Zócalo, Oaxaca City (Centro), Hierve el Agua, Puerto Escondido.
fields.description: Oaxaca is a culturally rich state in Mexico, famous for its ancient pyramids, vibrant indigenous markets, and world-class culinary traditions. The best time to visit is during the dry, cooler months from October to April. This window covers major cultural celebrations like the colorful Day of the Dead (late October/early November) and the Guelaguetza folk festival (July).

fields.places_covered: Galle Fort, Unawatuna Beach, Jungle Beach, Galle National Museum & Dutch Reformed Church, Japanese Peace Pagoda.
fields.description: Galle is a historic coastal city in southern Sri Lanka known for its 16th-century colonial architecture and palm-fringed beaches. It offers a perfect blend of rich heritage and relaxing seaside getaways.

fields.places_covered: Petronas Twin Towers, Batu Caves, Bukit Bintang, Jalan Alor, Merdeka Square, KLCC Park, Thean Hou Temple.
fields.description: Kuala Lumpur is the vibrant capital city of Malaysia, offering a perfect mix of futuristic skyscrapers and rich cultural heritage. Kuala Lumpur is a vibrant, modern metropolis renowned for its towering skyscrapers, cultural diversity, and world-class street food.

fields.places_covered: Big Lagoon, Small Lagoon, Secret Lagoon,  Nacpan Beach, Secret Beach, Matinloc Shrine, Helicopter Island, Taraw Cliff.
fields.description: El Nido is a stunning coastal town in the Philippines, famous for dramatic limestone cliffs, clear lagoons, and white-sand beaches.

fields.places_covered: Medina, Jardin Majorelle, Djemaa el-Fna, Bahia Palace, Koutoubia Mosque, Agafay Desert.
fields.description: Marrakech, located in Morocco, is a vibrant city known for its historic medina, bustling souks, and stunning palaces.

fields.places_covered: Philae Temple, Abu Simbel, The Unfinished Obelisk, Nubian Village, Aswan High Dam & Felucca Ride, Nubian Museum,
fields.description: Aswan is a serene, history-rich city in southern Egypt along the Nile River, renowned for its ancient monuments, vibrant Nubian culture, and striking desert landscapes.
